game_concept: A arcade set in Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge, a bridge of fixed ropes: the ice axe ranger must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the supply cache.
theme: Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge: a bridge of fixed ropes
core_gameplay_loop: In Sherpa Bridge, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the supply cache. Each round, a new oxygen tanks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 290 points of oxygen tanks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sherpa Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Sherpa Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
